description: Defines a class 'Compare' that performs comparison operations on data fields within the OFBiz mini-language framework, specifically comparing a field value to a specified static value during execution.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: A class extending BaseCompare, used for comparing a specific field's value against a predefined value within the mini-language operation framework.

methods.name: Compare
